name: Yolande's Regal Presence

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: creatures of your choice that the Emanation reaches

summary: A 10-foot aura of majesty: Wis save or 4d6 Psychic, Prone and pushed 10 feet; half damage on a success.
text: Creatures you choose save when the Emanation reaches them, when they enter it and when they end a turn in it, once per turn.
